about_pullquote: We started KM because we hated cowboys charging folk twice what a job should cost.
about_para_1: KM Plumbing Services was founded 15 years ago in Ashton-on-Ribble with one goal: to offer Preston homeowners honest, fast plumbing at fair prices. Over the years, we've built our reputation on turning up when we say we will and finishing the job right, first time. Today we handle everything from burst pipes at midnight to full heating system overhauls.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we quote upfront, explain the work in plain English, and never try to sell you something you don't need. We've completed over 1,000 jobs across Preston, Ashton, and the surrounding areas, and most of our work comes from repeat customers and personal recommendations. Your satisfaction is guaranteed — if you're not happy, we'll put it right.
reviews_heading: What Preston Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Woke up to a burst pipe on Boxing Day — absolute nightmare. Called KM and they were here in 50 minutes. Fixed it properly, cleaned up after themselves, and the price was exactly what they quoted on the phone. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had our old boiler replaced last month. The lads turned up on time, did a proper installation, explained everything as they went, and left the place spotless. Got a 10-year parts warranty too. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Margaret W.

reviews.text: Cold radiator upstairs and didn't want a huge bill. KM came round, bled the system, and sorted it for a fraction of what I expected. Honest pricing, no pushing extras. Will use them again.
reviews.author: Chris L.
